examples.subject: Partnership idea: SOC automation + incident response with Zion AI/IT services
examples.body:
Hi Paulina Xu,

At Zion Tech Group we deliver AI and IT services that help cybersecurity teams lower alert noise, accelerate incident response, and turn raw telemetry into actionable playbooks.

For a company like Agentic Fabriq, I see several mutually beneficial options:
- AI-assisted SOC triage and incident response automation
- Threat-detection enrichment and alert prioritization
- Free joint content: benchmark report or security automation toolkit
- Export-ready integration pack for your current tooling

You can explore our services and free tools here:
https://ziontechgroup.com

If helpful, I’d propose a 20-minute conversation this week to align on quick wins and a small pilot.

Calendly:
https://calendly.com/kleber-ziontechgroup

Best regards,
